⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Stream continuity marker.

Rows that share a `stream_id` are considered parts of the same logical
capture; a change in `stream_id` signals a recorder restart or resync and
is treated as an implicit discontinuity.
